NORMAL_100.capture_policy: full-state MAT; include protected variables; no scheduled trip

NORMAL_75.capture_policy: capture only after a physically defined and converged 75% operating point exists

NORMAL_50.capture_policy: capture only after a physically defined and converged 50% operating point exists

COLD_START.capture_policy: requires thermodynamically consistent cold plant state plus startup sequence
COLD_START.forbidden_shortcut: forcing pressure, temperature, flow and rpm to zero
